design_doc: A calm third-person exploration RPG in UE5. Player explores a countryside map, reads a generated stone tablet that says three treasure chests are hidden nearby. Each chest has a different NPC wandering nearby who can be talked to (press E) for hints. Bats fly around each chest location. No combat. Find and open all 3 chests to complete. Scene uses imported open-source countryside map. Player has 4 motion clips (idle/walk/run/interact), NPCs have 2 each (idle/wander), bats have 1 (fly). All 3D assets generated via Meshy API.
